profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cheq
profile.summary: Software engineering professional with 10 years of experience, specializing in Java, Javascript, Python and AWS. Open and able to learn new technologies and languages. Looking for opportunities building software that makes a positive impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and deployed infrastructure to improve privacy product package sizes, initialization times and code clarity with Handlebars and direct html editing of our consent experiences.

Improved customization and targeting of our enterprise data governance feature to allow for tracking of PII.

Designed and implemented audit history feature to allow enterprise users to have better peace of mind and willingness to adopt the product.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Designed and implemented solution to filter noise using aggregated data from our feedback loop in our SaaS portal. 

Assisted in migration of our browser compatibility tests to new platform using web-test-runner and playwright

Architected and built a brand hijacking fraud detection pipeline for various domain squatting techniques.

Enhanced our privacy consent experience to comply with the latest TCF2.2 and Google Additional Consent specifications. 

Implemented a pre-rendering prototype for our consent experience, enhancing client product readiness before launch.

Integrated new queuing mechanism through a REST API for better operational visibility when we submit changes through our code delivery network. 

Upgraded Spring boot versions from 2.6.8 to 3.2.1 to ensure we have proper LTS support going forward for our configuration UI servers. 

Migrated old REST calls from our old Akka based rest services to our new Spring Boot based rest services to enable more modern tag management features to be used in our privacy UI. 

Managed and identified root causes for on-call incidents, most recently an issue regarding availability for our privacy UI. Turned out to be a caching issue in Nginx. 

Built system for managing snapshots and artifacts of our visualizations and reports. 
Integrated the system into our Bamboo CICD pipeline to cover AWS's current inability to manage reports in Quicksight.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Achieved 90% cost reductions, quadrupling processing speed, and increased processing uptimes by migrating data pipeline operations to AWS Athena, saving on-call rotations.  

Introduced caching layer via SPICE storage in AWS Quicksight to increase reports responsiveness. Created scheduled service to manage promoting client data once they reach a certain threshold to use the caching mechanism. 

Migrated new domain detection mechanism to use new Step Function Architecture, speeding up processing times from 30 minutes to under 5 minutes.

Implemented pipeline development framework using SAM for deploying changes to our SQL, Step Functions and Lambdas in a single project directory. 

Created prototype for ML model deployment and evaluation on client websites and edge locations. 
Assisted in standing up new core library project to enable initiatives where processing of urls is needed in different products. Generated relevant files and packaging along with the testing needed for the new code.

Assisted in standing up new core library project to enable initiatives where processing of urls is needed in different products. Generated relevant files and packaging along with the testing needed for the new code.

Launched a service worker solution along with a cloudfront CDN to secure requests made through iframes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Transitioned our privacy gateway reporter and ingestion engine to use LZ4 compression versus LZString saving an average of 20% on S3 storage costs and reducing CPU utilization, drastically in worst case scenarios.  

Debugged various issues regarding our javascript code running in IE11, solutions included providing ponyfills and including new webpack polyfills as provided.

Implemented algorithm to modify packing reporting objects to alleviate strain on first party CDNs. This splits the objects into half size requests and checks if it matches the size criterion that is put on delivery networks.

Added coverage for tracking anchor tag links with our privacy gateway, this included configuration options in our UI. 

Enabled developer-oriented marketing teams to deploy their tags programmatically through the integration of git into our tag management platform. 

Implemented portions of a SAML 2.0 protocol for SSO to enable our enterprise tag management platform to integrate with client enterpise login systems.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · SQL · MySQL · Ansible · Python · MongoDB · Vue.js · Technical Architecture · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Technical Design · Asynchronous work · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer, Senior Associate
positions.description:
Revamped a comprehensive credit card account booking system for partner cards, streamlining the account handling process. 

Implemented KYC initiatives in order to comply with new banking regulations.

Won the 3D Innovation Challenge, at our BOOM! Innovation Expo using MongoDB, Nodejs and Angularjs.

Built Jenkins CICD  pipelines using a combination of Ruby, Shell scripts and Chef to support modernization initiatives and ensuring we can continuously improve partner card experience.

Implemented a RabbitMQ cluster and a dead letter queue using Chef and Ruby to handle failure cases for unprocessed credit card applications.

Maintained and reviewed code for deployment of Akka based batch update system

Researched and developed potential PoC candidates for replacement of mainframe orchestration system.

Played pivotal role in introducing the concepts of micro-servicing and Kafka streaming to the organization's architects, paving the way for enhanced system architecture.
positions.insights: Skills: Nodejs · Chef · MongoDB · Spring Framework · Angular.js · Technical Architecture · Apache Kafka · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Technical Design · Ruby · JavaScript

positions.title: Lead Software Engineering Research Intern
positions.description:
Managed team of software engineering interns to develop of an up and coming technology stack
Architected potential proof of concepts for multiple related products
Pitched and developed initial version of PoC to VP of Innovation
positions.insights: Skills: Internet of Things (IoT) · Node.js · REST APIs · iOS · Message Queue · JavaScript

positions.title: Co Founder, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Constructed web crawlers using Scrapy, a Python web crawling frame to seed website with initial data.
Created a script in Python and its related MySQL library to parse Json formatted data outputted from Scrapy
Constructed queries alongside PHP/Laravel to display data from a search request
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Freelance Programmer
positions.description:
Designed Vine style web page with sharing and viewing functionality
Implemented the video descriptions using the RESTful Parse API
Generated Twitter and Facebook Meta tags using PHP and the Parse API
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked on dry contact transfer of graphene from copper substrate to a silicon dioxide substrate. Using imaging techniques such as SEM and AFM to confirm whether graphene is transferred over. Also produced anodic aluminum oxide with long range ordered nanopores for fabrication applications.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Consultant
positions.description:
Developed a part of the RSA Encryption algorithm for usage in the Everpurse.
Created new quality control measures to assure the functionality of the Everpurse.
Designed and researched battery level monitoring system for integration into the Everpurse

projects.title: RSO Event Manager API
projects.description:
Created specifications for controllers and models to respond with json
Constructed factories to generate fake data for the test suite
Implementing routing in such a way to support multiple versions of the API

projects.title: Quota Budgeting Application
projects.description:
Produced and implemented test suite for the main classes used in the application
Designed and created a simple functional UI for daily usage
Implemented ViewPager functionality to improve navigation and UI experience
